symptom: `report traceability`: requirements anchored on a published REST service, a Java action or an attribute show footprint null and so 0 tests and 0 journeys
cause: The footprint matched published operations by `<Service>.%`, but the catalog names an operation's refs source `<Service> <resource> <METHOD> <path>` (space-separated); `java_action` had no case; an attribute used only in an expression has no member ref
file: `cmd/mxcli/projectreport/traceability.go` (`footprint`: operations table for a REST service, callers for a Java action, entity writers as an approximate fallback for an attribute)
insight: The anchor kinds a footprint must handle are the lower-cased objects.ObjectType values `brain plan --json` reports, and a refs source name is not always `Module.Document`: check the builder's naming (publishedRestOpName) before matching on a prefix. Found by running the report against an app with a hand-made version of it
